11,68,393 Ordinary Shares held by Rujuvalika Investments Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Steel Limited w.e.f May 8, 2015), do not carry any voting rights.
Tata AIA Life Insurance Company Limited is not considered part of the Promoter Group holds 15,95,907 Ordinary Shares representing 0.13% of the paid-up Ordinary Share Capital. Accordingly, holding of Tata AIA Life Insurance Company Ltd. is included under Public Shareholding under the head 'Institutions'-Insurance Companies.
NPS Trust - Various Trust Accounts having PAN AABTN0648L, under ‘Trusts’ holds 1,35,62,281 fully paid-up equity shares and 891 partly paid-up equity shares. The total voting rights held are 1,35,62,504 i.e., 1.13%
During the quarter ended June 30, 2018, the two Promoter Group Companies - Sir Ratan Tata Trust and Sir Dorabji Tata Trust had sold their entire holdings in Tata Steel Limited. Hence their holdings are 'NIL'.
Tata Sons Private Limited (TSPL) holds 32.93% in Tata Steel Limited as on March 24, 2021 and Tata Steel Limited is an associate of TSPL. TSPL being a Core Investment Company registered with RBI, is exempted under the Significant Beneficial Ownership (SBO) Rules. The Company does not have any other Significant Beneficial Owner under SBO Rules to be reported in the shareholding pattern as on March 24, 2021.
The Stakeholders Relationship Committee, duly authorized by the Board, at its, at its meeting held on March 24, 2021, approved the conversion of 7,02,49,241 partly paid up equity shares of face value Rs. 10 each into fully paid up equity shares of face value Rs. 10 each, against which the first and final call money of Rs. 461 per share has been received.
